title: [FE] VR PC (OPEN SOUrSe)
features:
How to use:
Execute the script.
Hold Q to move your left hand, or E for your right hand. The hand follows your mouse cursor.
Use the mouse wheel to move your hand closer or farther.
Press H to see all the controls.
Controls:
Q / E: left / right hand follows your cursor
G: hold both hands together (Shift + scroll changes the width)
F: mirror mode
Scroll: move hand closer / farther
Z / C: rotate wrist
1-3: load saved pose (Ctrl + 1-3 to save)
R: record movement, P: play it back
L: head follows your cursor
X: long reach
T: keep hands in place / auto return
[ and ]: change smoothness
N: no-clip other players
V: turn VR on / off
Y: reset
H: help, U: hide the GUI
Notes:
The game must have Nexus VR Character Model, or it won't work.
Other players only see what the server replicates, so long reach may look shorter for them.
If something breaks, rejoin and execute again.
script: local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local RunService = game:GetService("RunService") local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService") local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService") local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService") local Players = game:GetService("Players") local plr = Players.LocalPlayer local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera if shared.NexusVRPC_Cleanup then pcall(shared.NexusVRPC_Cleanup) end local remote pcall(function() local m = RS:WaitForChild("NexusVRCharacterModel", 8) remote = m:WaitForChild("UpdateInputs", 8) local ready = m:FindFirstChild("ReplicationReady") if ready then ready:FireServer() end end) local CFG = { sendRate = 1 / 30, smooth = 22, reach = 3.1, reachLong = 14, depth = 2.2, depthMin = 0.6, depthMax = 40, gripWidth = 0.9, rollSpeed = 3.5, maxRecord = 30, } local S = { enabled = true, autoReturn = true, headLook = false, longReach = false, noclip = true, hud = true, help = false, recording = false, playing = false, } local sin, cos, exp, clamp, abs = math.sin, math.cos, math.exp, math.clamp, math.abs local V3 = Vector3.new local DOWN = V3(0, -1, 0) local conns = {} local function bind(signal, fn) conns[#conns + 1] = signal:Connect(fn) end local function newHand(sign) local rest = V3(sign * 1.0, -0.7, -0.6) return { sign = sign, shoulder = V3(sign * 1.0, 0.6, 0), rest = rest, pos = rest, vel = V3(0, 0, 0), target = rest, roll = 0, rollTarget = 0, depth = CFG.depth, pinned = false, cf = CFrame.new(rest), dir = DOWN, } end local hands = {L = newHand(-1), R = newHand(1)} local currentMode = nil local headSmooth = nil local state = {valid = false, rootCF = CFrame.new(), headCF = CFrame.new(), dirL = DOWN, dirR = DOWN} local slots = {} local rec = {frames = {}, t = 0} local play = {t = 0, i = 1} local function make(class, props, parent) local o = Instance.new(class) for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end o.Parent = parent return o end local function getParent() if gethui then local ok, g = pcall(gethui) if ok and g then return g end end local ok, core = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end) if ok and core then local tested = pcall(function() local t = Instance.new("Folder") t.Parent = core t:Destroy() end) if tested then return core end end return plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end local parentGui = getParent() if parentGui:FindFirstChild("NexusVR_PC") then parentGui.NexusVR_PC:Destroy() end local gui = make("ScreenGui", { Name = "NexusVR_PC", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 99999, IgnoreGuiInset = true, }, parentGui) local panel = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 158), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, BorderSizePixel = 0, }, gui) make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)}, panel) make("UIStroke", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255), Transparency = 0.5, Thickness = 1.2}, panel) local statusLabel = make("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 7), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, RichText = true, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 235, 245), Text = "", }, panel) local helpPanel = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(330, 262), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 182), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, }, gui) make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)}, helpPanel) make("UIStroke", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255), Transparency = 0.5, Thickness = 1.2}, helpPanel) local helpLines = { "CONTROLES", "Q / E mano izq / der sigue el cursor", "G agarre a dos manos (Shift+rueda: ancho)", "F modo espejo", "Rueda profundidad de la mano activa", "Z / C girar muñeca", "1-3 cargar pose Ctrl+1-3 guardar", "R grabar P reproducir / parar", "T mantener posición / retorno auto", "L cabeza sigue el cursor", "X alcance largo", "[ ] suavidad", "N no-clip jugadores", "V VR on/off Y reiniciar", "H esta ayuda U ocultar HUD", } make("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 7), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, RichText = true, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 235, 245), Text = table.concat(helpLines, "\n"), }, helpPanel) local function makeMarker(color, letter) local f = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = 0.55, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, }, gui) make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, f) make("UIStroke", {Color = color, Thickness = 2, Transparency = 0.1}, f) make("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = letter, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, }, f) return f end local markerL = makeMarker(Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), "I") local markerR = makeMarker(Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 255), "D") local toast = make("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(380, 30), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -60), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextStrokeTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16, Text = "", }, gui) local toastId = 0 local function notify(text) toastId = toastId + 1 local id = toastId toast.Text = text toast.TextTransparency = 0 toast.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4 task.delay(1.6, function() if id == toastId and toast.Parent then TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1}):Play() end end) end local function modeName(m) if m == "L" then return "mano izquierda" elseif m == "R" then return "mano derecha" elseif m == "both" then return "agarre dos manos" elseif m == "mirror" then return "espejo" end return "libre" end local function refreshStatus() local on = S.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF' local lines = { "NEXUS VR · PC " .. on, "Modo: " .. modeName(currentMode), string.format("Profundidad: I %.1f · D %.1f", hands.L.depth, hands.R.depth), string.format("Suavidad: %.0f · Agarre: %.1f", CFG.smooth, CFG.gripWidth), "Manos: " .. (S.autoReturn and "retorno auto" or "mantener"), "Cabeza: " .. (S.headLook and "sigue cursor" or "cámara"), "Alcance: " .. (S.longReach and "largo" or "normal"), } if S.recording then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format('● REC %.1fs', rec.t) elseif S.playing then lines[#lines + 1] = '▶ reproduciendo' elseif not remote then lines[#lines + 1] = 'sin remote de Nexus VR' else lines[#lines + 1] = "H = ayuda" end statusLabel.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n") end local function rotBetween(from, to) local dot = clamp(from:Dot(to), -1, 1) local axis = from:Cross(to) if axis.Magnitude < 1e-4 then if dot > 0 then return CFrame.new() end return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.xAxis, math.pi) end return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, math.acos(dot)) end local joints = {} local function refreshJoints(char) if joints.char == char and joints.neck and joints.neck.Parent then return end joints.char = char joints.neck = char:FindFirstChild("Neck", true) joints.L = char:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder", true) or char:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder", true) joints.R = char:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder", true) or char:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder", true) end local function applyJoints() if not S.enabled or not state.valid then return end local char = plr.Character if not char then return end refreshJoints(char) local n, l, r = joints.neck, joints.L, joints.R if n and n.Part0 then n.Transform = n.C0.Rotation:Inverse() * n.Part0.CFrame.Rotation:Inverse() * state.headCF.Rotation * n.C1.Rotation end if l and l.Part0 then local fr = l.Part0.CFrame * l.C0 l.Transform = rotBetween(DOWN, fr:VectorToObjectSpace(state.dirL)) end if r and r.Part0 then local fr = r.Part0.CFrame * r.C0 r.Transform = rotBetween(DOWN, fr:VectorToObjectSpace(state.dirR)) end end local function resetJoints() local char = plr.Character if not char then return end refreshJoints(char) for _, j in ipairs({joints.neck, joints.L, joints.R}) do if j then j.Transform = CFrame.new() end end end local function key(k) return UIS:IsKeyDown(k) and not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() end local function getMode() if key(Enum.KeyCode.G) then return "both" end if key(Enum.KeyCode.F) then return "mirror" end local l, r = key(Enum.KeyCode.Q), key(Enum.KeyCode.E) if l and r then return "both" end if l then return "L" end if r then return "R" end return nil end local function clampReach(h, p) local v = p - h.shoulder local maxR = S.longReach and CFG.reachLong or CFG.reach if v.Magnitude > maxR then v = v.Unit * maxR end return h.shoulder + v end local function stepSpring(h, target, dt) local w = CFG.smooth local e = exp(-w * dt) local x = h.pos - target local tmp = h.vel + x * w h.pos = target + (x + tmp * dt) * e h.vel = (h.vel - tmp * w * dt) * e h.roll = h.roll + (h.rollTarget - h.roll) * (1 - exp(-w * dt)) end local function buildHandCF(h) local v = h.pos - h.shoulder local dir = v.Magnitude > 0.05 and v.Unit or DOWN h.dir = dir local up = abs(dir.Y) > 0.98 and V3(0, 0, -1) or Vector3.yAxis h.cf = CFrame.lookAt(h.pos, h.pos + dir, up) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, h.roll) end local function savePose(n) slots[n] = { L = {pos = hands.L.pos, roll = hands.L.roll}, R = {pos = hands.R.pos, roll = hands.R.roll}, } notify("Pose " .. n .. " guardada") end local function loadPose(n) local s = slots[n] if not s then notify("Pose " .. n .. " vacía") return end for k, h in pairs(hands) do h.target = s[k].pos h.rollTarget = s[k].roll h.pinned = true end notify("Pose " .. n .. " cargada") end local function startRecording() rec.frames = {} rec.t = 0 S.recording = true S.playing = false notify("● Grabando (R para terminar)") end local function stopRecording() S.recording = false notify("Grabación lista: " .. #rec.frames .. " cuadros") end local function startPlayback() if #rec.frames < 2 then notify("No hay nada grabado") return end S.playing = true S.recording = false play.t = 0 play.i = 1 notify("▶ Reproduciendo (P para parar)") end local function sampleRecording(tm) local f = rec.frames local n = #f local i = play.i if i > n - 1 then i = 1 end while i < n - 1 and f[i + 1].t < tm do i = i + 1 end play.i = i local a, b = f[i], f[i + 1] local span = math.max(b.t - a.t, 1e-4) return a, b, clamp((tm - a.t) / span, 0, 1) end local function resetAll() for _, h in pairs(hands) do h.target = h.rest h.rollTarget = 0 h.depth = CFG.depth h.pinned = false end S.recording = false S.playing = false notify("Reiniciado") end local function toggleEnabled() S.enabled = not S.enabled if not S.enabled then state.valid = false resetJoints() end notify(S.enabled and "VR activado" or "VR desactivado") end bind(UIS.InputBegan, function(input) if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end local k = input.KeyCode local ctrl = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl) if k == Enum.KeyCode.V then toggleEnabled() elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.T then S.autoReturn = not S.autoReturn notify(S.autoReturn and "Retorno automático" or "Mantener posición") elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.L then S.headLook = not S.headLook notify(S.headLook and "Cabeza sigue el cursor" or "Cabeza sigue la cámara") elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.X then S.longReach = not S.longReach notify(S.longReach and "Alcance largo" or "Alcance normal") elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.N then S.noclip = not S.noclip notify(S.noclip and "No-clip jugadores ON" or "No-clip jugadores OFF") elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.H then S.help = not S.help helpPanel.Visible = S.help and S.hud elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.U then S.hud = not S.hud panel.Visible = S.hud helpPanel.Visible = S.hud and S.help elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Y then resetAll() elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.R and not ctrl then if S.recording then stopRecording() else startRecording() end elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.P then if S.playing then S.playing = false notify("Reproducción detenida") else startPlayback() end elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket then CFG.smooth = clamp(CFG.smooth - 2, 6, 60) elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket then CFG.smooth = clamp(CFG.smooth + 2, 6, 60) elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.One or k == Enum.KeyCode.Two or k == Enum.KeyCode.Three then local n = k == Enum.KeyCode.One and 1 or (k == Enum.KeyCode.Two and 2 or 3) if ctrl then savePose(n) else loadPose(n) end end end) CAS:BindActionAtPriority("NexusVRPC_Wheel", function(_, inputState, input) if not S.enabled or not currentMode then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end if inputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Change then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end local dz = input.Position.Z if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) and currentMode == "both" then CFG.gripWidth = clamp(CFG.gripWidth + dz * 0.1, 0.2, 4) else local d = dz * 0.2 local function bump(h) h.depth = clamp(h.depth + d, CFG.depthMin, CFG.depthMax) end if currentMode == "L" then bump(hands.L) elseif currentMode == "R" then bump(hands.R) else bump(hands.L) bump(hands.R) end end return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value, Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel) local lastSend = 0 local statusAcc = 0 bind(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt) dt = math.min(dt, 0.1) cam = workspace.CurrentCamera statusAcc = statusAcc + dt if statusAcc >= 0.1 then statusAcc = 0 refreshStatus() end local char = plr.Character local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if not root or not S.enabled then state.valid = false markerL.Visible = false markerR.Visible = false return end local now = os.clock() local rootCF = root.CFrame local chest = rootCF.Position + rootCF.UpVector * 0.6 local loc = UIS:GetMouseLocation() local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(loc.X, loc.Y) local function pointAt(depth) local s = (chest - ray.Origin):Dot(ray.Direction) + depth return rootCF:PointToObjectSpace(ray.Origin + ray.Direction * s) end local mode = getMode() currentMode = mode local activeL = mode == "L" or mode == "both" or mode == "mirror" local activeR = mode == "R" or mode == "both" or mode == "mirror" if mode == "L" then hands.L.target = clampReach(hands.L, pointAt(hands.L.depth)) elseif mode == "R" then hands.R.target = clampReach(hands.R, pointAt(hands.R.depth)) elseif mode == "both" then local p = pointAt((hands.L.depth + hands.R.depth) / 2) local rv = rootCF:VectorToObjectSpace(cam.CFrame.RightVector) hands.L.target = clampReach(hands.L, p - rv * (CFG.gripWidth / 2)) hands.R.target = clampReach(hands.R, p + rv * (CFG.gripWidth / 2)) elseif mode == "mirror" then local p = pointAt(hands.R.depth) local x = math.max(abs(p.X), 0.3) hands.R.target = clampReach(hands.R, V3(x, p.Y, p.Z)) hands.L.target = clampReach(hands.L, V3(-x, p.Y, p.Z)) end local rd = (key(Enum.KeyCode.Z) and -1 or 0) + (key(Enum.KeyCode.C) and 1 or 0) for k, h in pairs(hands) do local active = (k == "L" and activeL) or (k == "R" and activeR) if active then h.pinned = false if rd ~= 0 then h.rollTarget = h.rollTarget + rd * CFG.rollSpeed * dt end elseif S.autoReturn and not h.pinned and not S.playing then h.target = h.rest h.rollTarget = 0 end end if S.recording then rec.t = rec.t + dt rec.frames[#rec.frames + 1] = { t = rec.t, L = {pos = hands.L.target, roll = hands.L.rollTarget}, R = {pos = hands.R.target, roll = hands.R.rollTarget}, } if rec.t >= CFG.maxRecord then stopRecording() end end if S.playing then play.t = play.t + dt local total = rec.frames[#rec.frames].t if play.t > total then play.t = play.t - total play.i = 1 end local a, b, al = sampleRecording(play.t) for k, h in pairs(hands) do local active = (k == "L" and activeL) or (k == "R" and activeR) if not active then h.target = a[k].pos:Lerp(b[k].pos, al) h.rollTarget = a[k].roll + (b[k].roll - a[k].roll) * al h.pinned = true end end end local phase = 0 for _, h in pairs(hands) do local sway = V3(0, sin(now * 1.6 + phase) * 0.012, cos(now * 1.3 + phase) * 0.008) stepSpring(h, h.target + sway, dt) buildHandCF(h) phase = phase + 1.5 end local headPos = rootCF.Position + V3(0, 2, 0) local headTarget if S.headLook then headTarget = CFrame.lookAt(headPos, headPos + ray.Direction) else headTarget = CFrame.new(headPos) * cam.CFrame.Rotation end if S.headLook and headSmooth then headSmooth = headSmooth:Lerp(headTarget, 1 - exp(-dt * 18)) else headSmooth = headTarget end state.valid = true state.rootCF = rootCF state.headCF = headSmooth state.dirL = rootCF:VectorToWorldSpace(hands.L.dir) state.dirR = rootCF:VectorToWorldSpace(hands.R.dir) applyJoints() if remote and now - lastSend >= CFG.sendRate then lastSend = now remote:FireServer(headSmooth, rootCF * hands.L.cf, rootCF * hands.R.cf) end if S.hud then local pl, onL = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootCF:PointToWorldSpace(hands.L.pos)) local pr, onR = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootCF:PointToWorldSpace(hands.R.pos)) markerL.Visible = onL markerR.Visible = onR markerL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pl.X, pl.Y) markerR.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pr.X, pr.Y) markerL.BackgroundTransparency = activeL and 0.2 or 0.7 markerR.BackgroundTransparency = activeR and 0.2 or 0.7 else markerL.Visible = false markerR.Visible = false end end) local ncAcc = 0 bind(RunService.Stepped, function(_, dt) applyJoints() if S.noclip then ncAcc = ncAcc + dt if ncAcc >= 0.1 then ncAcc = 0 for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if other ~= plr and other.Character then for _, p in ipairs(other.Character:GetChildren()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end end end end end end end) shared.NexusVRPC_Cleanup = function() for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end CAS:UnbindAction("NexusVRPC_Wheel") S.enabled = false resetJoints() if gui then gui:Destroy() end shared.NexusVRPC_Cleanup = nil end refreshStatus() notify("Nexus VR PC listo · H para ayuda")
